== flags

== quote-all
a\ b	
it\'s\ \$HOME	
say\ \"hi\"	
\`touch\ pwned\`	
\$\(touch\ pwned\)	
x\;touch\ pwned	
star\*	
\~root	
$'o\342\200\231neil;touch pwned'	
$'\342\200\234q\342\200\235'	
back\\slash	
a\\:b	
C:\\Users\\me	
a\!b	
ends\'	
\{a\,b\}	
a\&b\|c\<d\>e	
\#hash	
true	
null	
-foo.bar	
--%
